exactResults.constantSpectralAngle: not identifiable separately from systemic radial velocity in the declared single-channel model

exactResults.spatialAngle: not identifiable from observed cluster covariance without an independently fixed intrinsic covariance

ordinarySpatialControl.interpretation: ordinary sky-plane catalogue axis only; not a configuration T1 measurement

crossChannelDiagnostic.status: executed exploratory diagnostic; reproducible residual structure detected; physical attribution open
crossChannelDiagnostic.astrometryAndSpectroscopySource: Gaia DR3 gaia_source joined through dr2_neighbourhood
crossChannelDiagnostic.method: fit one ICRS space-velocity vector from Gaia DR3 proper motions and parallaxes without spectroscopic RV; predict astrometric RV; subtract from Gaia DR3 spectroscopic RV; regress robust-inlier residuals on signed published-catalogue PCA coordinate anchored at the median cluster centre

frozenModelGate.corpusNativeT1Model: r(s)=a; cluster-wide theta and q enter only as a constant projection factor and are predictively identical to the intercept-only null
frozenModelGate.reason: the corpus supplies no theta(s) evolution law, boundary condition or coupling kernel from which a spatial derivative can be predicted
frozenModelGate.ordinarySurrogate: r(s)=a+b*s; literature-motivated linear tail-velocity trend, not a replacement for the published N-body particle model
frozenModelGate.comparisonStatus: retrospective five-fold rehearsal; not confirmatory because the aggregate gradient was inspected before the split and model freeze
frozenModelGate.training: Theil-Sen line for ordinary surrogate; training median for constant comparator
frozenModelGate.interpretation: a linear spatial kinematic term generalizes slightly better than a constant offset; this does not identify its physical cause and supplies no evidence for T1

alternativeShapeTournament.status: retrospective nested five-fold hypothesis discovery; not confirmatory
alternativeShapeTournament.coordinate: signed angular coordinate along the published-catalogue sky-plane principal axis
alternativeShapeTournament.result: spatial structure generalizes versus a constant offset, but no tested boundary or relaxation shape is distinguishable from an ordinary linear tail term
alternativeShapeTournament.nextDiscriminator: three-dimensional tail position with uncertainty, frozen ordinary phase-space predictions, or untouched spectroscopy outside the current angular window
